scope: Proposition 4.5 of the manuscript “A hyperbolic group with no geometric CAT(0) action” (preprints/A-hyperbolic-group-with-no-geometric-CAT0-action-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 257 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 124f55b0821cc7f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any finite family T of conditional tests, there is a neighborhood of the critical parameters such that every sufficiently small fixed positive (α, β, δ) in that neighborhood with β > 7α has the following properties as N → ∞. With probability tending to one, the master pattern has a nonempty set of matches, its count is |Ωn| = (1 + o(1))N3−β−90δ , every single-field marginal of its uniform law µN is o(1) in total variation from the uniform law on Sn, and every test in T has the coupling of Lemma 4.4. The six-letter counts also satisfy Equation (4.16). All these properties concern only the tables and are independent of any choice of action or metric space.
